name: glossary
title: Glossary / Term
description: RF-5 inline Term and compact Glossary list. Terms open an accessible anchored popover without navigation; optional recallPrompt keeps the definition out of the DOM until explicitly revealed, converting passive lookup into an active-recall moment. Supports controlled state, partial streaming entries, localized labels and empty state, rich definitions/examples, keyboard operation, Escape focus restoration, and token-only styling.
